channel.title: Texas Legislature - Today's Filed Bills in the Senate
channel.description: Bills filed on 11/20/2026. An appearance of a bill on this list is a result of it being filed by a representative or senator.

item.title: SB 460 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to the administration of immunizations to children and adults, including required written informed consent to those immunizations and civil liability for failure to obtain the consent; providing administrative penalties.

item.title: SB 461 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to the removal of certain power facilities operated on leased property.

item.title: SB 462 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Zaffirini
item.description: Relating to sentencing and community supervision procedures, including for family violence offenders.

item.title: SB 463 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Zaffirini
item.description: Relating to the disclosure of confidential juvenile records to a managed assigned counsel program.

item.title: SB 464 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to a notification requirement if certain public schools do not have a nurse assigned to the school during all instructional hours.

item.title: SB 465 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to the misuse of money received for an open-enrollment charter school to support an out-of-state school.

item.title: SB 466 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to the removal of a conservator, board of managers, or other alternative management of a campus or school district in certain circumstances.

item.title: SB 467 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to the issuance of a transcript by a public institution of higher education to a student who fails to pay certain student fees.

item.title: SB 468 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to prohibiting a public school from discriminating or retaliating against an employee for reporting certain misconduct.

item.title: SB 469 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to parental notification that a public school educator was engaged in romantic or sexual misconduct with a student enrolled at the school.

item.title: SB 470 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to the applicability of certain financial provisions to campus or campus program charter schools.

item.title: SB 471 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to measures to assist students enrolled at public institutions of higher education who are homeless or who are or were in foster care.

item.title: SB 472 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to authorizing school districts to provide funding using money received under the Foundation School Program to community-based organizations for purposes of reimbursing private employers for paid internships provided to certain students in career and technology education programs in the district.

item.title: SB 473 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to the requirement for educators serving as superintendents, directors, or principals of educational entities to report certain educator misconduct; increasing an administrative penalty.

item.title: SB 474 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Miles
item.description: Relating to the consideration of differentials among students from different racial and ethnic groups based on sex under the public school accountability system.
